set.body: Build the typed connectivity algebra that carries Ariadne durable semantics into ScalaFIM without porting the R S3/list surface. Scope: create a shared Scala 3 connectivity core over linalg/multivar only; keep dataset, atlas, BIDS, plotting, JVM IO, TVGL, SRLC, phase/HMM internals, and estimator-heavy work out of the first structural slice. Core shape: validated time-series inputs, node/time/run axes, edge topology, edge spaces, connectivity matrices, dynamic connectivity, subject-level connectivity sets, explicit vectorization order, preprocessing/estimator plan ADTs, typed diagnostics, and static/dynamic workflow bones. Acceptance: the new core has Odersky-style ADTs/opaque ids/smart constructors, module boundaries are documented, JVM and JS structural tests pass, and the first parity fixtures lock Ariadne edge ordering and basic connectivity semantics before algorithmic expansion.
set.title: EPIC: Connectivity core structures for ScalaFIM
